== Summary ==
Decipher's errata for Trample: the entry “Trample” in Decipher's ''Star Wars CCG Glossary'', Version 2.0 (November 1998), PDF page 131. Image for [[Trample (Decipher Errata 1998)]].

Source: [http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf swccgglossary.pdf], archived copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf 20061215115652]; wiki copy [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf]] (SHA-1 <code>b3838634d3e1379e527f0914f7816f5b0c130c89</code>). Cut unchanged from a 300 dpi render of PDF page 131 (pdftoppm -r 300), around the entry's title and revised game text with a 6-point margin.

SHA-1 <code>559a57f3121b697fd7d1975832d5e68a1aa59aa1</code>, SHA-256 <code>5f5f1c5d065b2a3078ceae02b1eb6195ca1a0c17770bcb09dcef9bb26ee637e3</code>.
